title: Feature List
description: Batch-scope task manifest: vertical slices the generator implements and the evaluator verifies. Lives only during a batch (specs/_batch/feature-list.json); archived to specs/completed/{slug}/ on /finalize. The codebase is the SSoT for per-feature details after the batch ends.

batch_slug.description: Batch identifier (kebab-case). Names specs/completed/{slug}/ and tags master .history.md entries.

base_commit.description: Git commit hash the planner started from. Lets sensors detect drift if anyone pushes during the batch.

name.description: Human-readable kebab-case slug. Last segment of module_path under the stack's case rules.

status.description: Terminal verdict on this feature. Planner writes `todo`. Harness-loop sets `passed` on evaluator PASS, `deferred` on evaluator DEFERRED or 3 failed rounds, `blocked-by-ancestor` when an upstream feature in `depends_on` is `deferred`/`blocked-by-ancestor`. WIP is implicit (no terminal row yet in `specs/_batch/progress.tsv`) — not stored here.

priority.description: Feature-level priority. P1 = blocker (batch can't ship without it). P2 = important. P3 = nice-to-have.

depends_on.description: Same-batch feature ids this feature requires DONE before it can start. Cross-batch dependencies belong in spec.preconditions.

decision_refs.description: Paths to existing ADRs (docs/adr/NNNN-*.md) this feature relies on. Reference only; new ADRs come from the planner's proposed-ADR set.

module_path.description: Repo-relative directory the feature owns. Generator creates files here; evaluator architectural_reflection.py verifies it exists.

mutation_threshold.description: Mutation-score floor as a percentage. A future stack-specific mutation adapter (consuming sensors.ini [mutation]) FAILs the feature if its score (killed / (killed + survived)) falls below this. Default 70; set 80 for hard-to-reverse modules. 0 disables mutation enforcement for this feature even if the stack's [mutation] section is configured.

acl_pairs.description: Anti-corruption-layer constraints this feature relies on. Each pair declares: a domain module path that MUST NOT directly import any package in `forbidden`. The pre-commit gate's module-ACL stage renders these into per-stack lint config (Python → import-linter contract; TS → dependency-cruiser rule) using the active stack skill's sensors.ini. Empty default = feature has no ACL constraint and the module-ACL stage SKIPs for this feature.

quarantined_tests.description: Tracked exceptions to '100% test pass'. Each entry: a test that fails or is unstable but the generator could not (or chose not to) fix this round. Replaces silent .skip / xfail. Rate limit: generator may add ≤1 entry per round (enforced by harness-loop). /finalize archive REFUSES to proceed if any entry's expires_after_batch == current_batch_slug — those must be resolved (entry removed) or have their expires_after_batch extended before archive.

domain.description: Module path of the protected domain (e.g. 'src.domain' for Python, 'src/domain' for TS). Format follows the active stack skill's import convention.

forbidden.description: External package names that domain modules MUST NOT import directly. e.g., ['boto3', 'stripe', 'requests'].

adapter_hint.description: Optional. Where domain code SHOULD route through instead (e.g. 'src.adapters.aws'). Informational only — used in error messages when a violation fires; not enforced by the module-ACL stage.

test_id.description: Unique test identifier — function name, group label, or path:line. Used by future batches to find and resolve. e.g., 'test_AC_02_email_validation' or 'foo.test.ts:42'.

ac_id.description: AC the quarantined test was meant to verify. ac_coverage gate still expects the AC's anchors to appear elsewhere; quarantine is per-test, not per-AC.

quarantine_reason.description: ≥10 chars. Must describe a SPECIFIC cause; bare reasons like 'flaky' alone are insufficient. Examples: 'race condition between fixture and DB cleanup; needs lock', 'mock server returns 502 occasionally; investigate retry policy', 'platform-dependent timing on M-series chips; pinning host'.

expires_after_batch.description: Batch slug this quarantine MUST be resolved by. /finalize refuses archive if any quarantine entry has expires_after_batch == current_batch_slug AND the entry is still present. Use the next foreseeable batch slug; do NOT use 'never' or the current batch's own slug as a perpetual escape.

user_story.description: One-sentence Cohn-form user story: "As a {role} I {action} so that {value}."

preconditions.description: State the feature assumes (Cockburn preconditions / Pact providerState). Cross-batch dependencies live here, not in depends_on.

business_rules.description: Feature-local business rules. Cross-feature rules belong in plan.md ## Architectural Decisions, not here.

open_questions.description: Questions raised during /prd grill. Each must declare resolution_kind so /finalize knows where the answer sinks.

ac.description: Acceptance criteria. Each is one discriminating eval. "10 great evals" cap; over 10 = split the feature.

question.description: The unresolved question (raised in /prd grill or by planner during design).

resolution_kind.description: Routing for the answer when /finalize sinks. feature_local → spec.business_rules (dies with batch). architectural → docs/adr/NNNN-*.md (proposed → accepted). glossary → CONTEXT.md (Domain terms section). No deferred — every question resolves in-batch or batch scope is wrong (escalate at /plan Phase 2 walk).

resolution.description: Answer text — non-empty at all times. Planner writes a recommended resolution at /plan Phase 1 self-verify; user reviews/edits/approves at /plan Phase 2 per-Q walk. If planner cannot recommend, the batch scope is wrong: escalate, do not write null.

title.description: Short headline used as test group name suffix.

kind.description: Eval kind. positive = happy path. negative = behavior the user MUST NOT observe. error = system-level error condition (network, DB down).

priority.description: AC-level priority. P1 fail = batch BLOCKED. P2 fail = retry. P3 fail = WARN + AskUserQuestion.

then.description: Gherkin Then clause: expected outcome. Must contain MUST NOT when kind = negative.

eval_anchors.description: Literal strings the test file must contain (visible text or test ids — language-neutral). ac_content_gate.py greps the test file for each anchor.

must_not.description: Literal strings the test file must NOT contain in the negative scenario. Required non-empty when kind = negative.

example.description: Worked example with real values, helps generator instantiate placeholder vars. Optional.

l1_command.description: Static-analysis command. The active stack skill provides the template (e.g. linter + module path).

l2_path.description: Unit/component test directory the runner targets.

l5_smoke_path.description: End-to-end smoke test file path. null when this feature does not need L5 (e.g., pure backend or data-model-only). UI features must have a non-null l5_smoke_path.
